rival_explanations: Fires on any frequent whole-word token completing a common bigram collocation (best way, states where, whole time), regardless of adjunct semantics, so near-synonym non-adjunct swaps like way/soup or where/that stay equally active.

Fires only as a narrow unigram detector for the specific English tokens way and where (with foreign subword lookalikes such as ov and to as offshoots), so other adjunct heads like manner, time, if, unless, or elsewhere are predicted inactive.

An Introduction to the New Testament: Contexts, Methods & Ministry Formation(2004)
A 2005 Gold Medallion finalist! Some introductions to the New Testament highlight the historical contexts in which the New Testament literature was written. This introduction gives particular attention to the social, cultural and rhetorical contexts of the New Testament authors and their writings. Few introductions to the New Testament integrate instruction in exegetical and interpretive strategies with their customary considerations of authorship, dating, audience and message. This introduction capitalizes on the opportunities, introducing students to a relevant facet of interpretation with each portion of New Testament literature. Rarely do introductions to the New Testament approach their task mindful of the needs of students preparing for ministry. This introduction is explicit in doing so, assuming as it does that the New Testament itself--in its parts and as a whole--is a pastoral response. Each chapter on the New Testament literature closes with a discussion of the implications for ministry formation. These integrative features alone would distinguish this introduction from others. But in addition, its pages brim with maps, photos, points of interest and aids to learning. Separate chapters explore the historical and cultural environment of the New Testament era, the nature of the Gospels and the quest for the historical Jesus, and the life of Paul. This introduction by David A. deSilva sets a new standard for its genre and is bound to appeal to many who believe that the New Testament should be introduced as if both scholarship and ministry mattered.
- New Testament
Publication DateJuly, 2004
Citation InformationDavid deSilva. An Introduction to the New Testament: Contexts, Methods & Ministry Formation. Downers Grove, IL(2004)
Available at: http://works.bepress.com/david_desilva/6/

赵重应（，），本贯楊州趙氏，是朝鲜王朝和大韩帝国的一位政治家。他被今日的韩国人认为是一个亲日派人物，为庚戌国贼和丁未七贼之一。

出生在汉城一个少论派的两班家族。1883年被任命为西北边界调查委员，前往西伯利亚、满洲、外蒙古等地调查。两年后归国，力主亲日反清的北防南开论，遭驪興閔氏的弹劾，流放全罗道宝城。1890年特赦归京。中日甲午战争爆发之前，随李垠前往日本，后任外务衙门的参议，与日本关系非常亲密。1895年，发生乙未事变，闵妃被杀，赵重应负责处理事后事务，包括废闵妃为庶人的事务。

1898年金弘集内阁倒台之后被剥夺一切职务，流亡日本。期间在日本学习近代农业技术以及政治学、法学，1906年获特赦归国。1907年任李完用内阁的法部大臣兼刑法改定总裁。同年参与签订第三次日韩协约，获得勋二等太极章、升正二品资宪大夫。他也因此被韩国人斥为丁未七贼之一。

1908年任农商工部大臣。1910年，参与日韩合并条约的签订，被日本列为朝鲜贵族，封子爵，任朝鲜总督府中枢院顾问。

赵重应被今日的韩国政府列为亲日反民族行为者之一。

Zwiftはバーチャルサイクリングの先駆者ではなく、Zwift誕生以前にも仮想現実でトレーニングをする同様のソフトウェアは存在した。しかし、3D技術を駆使して多くのユーザーを呼び込み、屋内サイクリングという新しい業界を定着させたという点でZwiftが大きな役割を果たしたといえる。また、「ズイフター(Zwifter)」という言葉が一般的な自転車用語として定着した。

バーチャルサイクリングの歴史 
屋内トレーニングにはいくつものメリットがある。例えば天候が悪いときに屋外でトレーニングするのは危険がつきまとうが、屋内では安全にトレーニングができる。怪我からのリハビリテーションにもインドアトレーニングが有効とされる。地形や交通、信号などの影響を受けないため、必要なトレーニング強度、時間に応じて正確な練習ができる。

器具を用いた屋内サイクリングは非常に長い歴史があり、原始的な屋内トレーニング器具は1880年代にすでに登場している。コンピューターや録画器具がなかった頃は、サイクリストにとって屋内トレーニングはきわめて退屈で、能力を維持するためにいやいや行うこととされていた。「壁をぼーっと見つめる」という言葉もこの頃から使われるようになった。この時代には音楽を聴くことが唯一の楽しみだった。

1980、1990年代になると、VHSなどの映像機器が登場し、ツール・ド・フランスなどの映像を見ながらトレーニングができるようになった。

トレーニングビデオが一般的になった頃には、すでにビデオゲーム形式のトレーニングソフトウェアが登場し始め、Exergaming (エクササイズとゲームを合わせた造語)と呼ばれた。最初のものは1980年に登場した Autodesk Highcycleとされる。建築設計企業のAutodeskが開発し、専用のトレーニング機器を必要とした。1982年には、ATARIが "puffer" というコードネームで、同社の8ビットコンピュータに接続して使用することを想定し、ペダルとハンドルの操作を行う専用の機器を開発していた。しかしアタリショックの影響でこのプロジェクトは中止となり、日の目を見ることはなかった。

adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests novel manner adjunct head in new noun plus manner collocation.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: They arrived at the exact time the museum gates opened yesterday morning.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests novel time adjunct head introducing a temporal clause.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: You may borrow the car if you return it with a full tank tonight.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests conditional if adjunct in a novel borrowing context.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Tired doctors kept working even when the night shift ran long yesterday.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests concessive even adjunct head in mid-sentence lowercase token with preceding context.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Admission fees vary according to age and residency status each year for visitors.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests according contingency adjunct in a novel fee context.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The outdoor concert proceeds depending on weather conditions tomorrow evening by the lake.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests depending contingency adjunct in a novel concert context.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The gates stay locked unless visitors show valid identification tomorrow at noon sharp.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests unless as a novel condition contingency head beyond the claimed list.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: After the fire they settled elsewhere far from the crowded coastal city last winter.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests elsewhere as a novel place adjunct head predicted inactive by the narrow detector.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Quedate donde la noche es larga y tranquila hoy.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests place adjunct in Spanish with donde as cross-lingual counterpart of where.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Avisame si terminas el informe antes de la reunion de manana por favor.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests conditional adjunct in Spanish with si as cross-lingual counterpart of if.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: This is the best soup to warm you on cold winter evenings here.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Swaps way for soup in a best plus noun frame to test collocation without adjunct semantics.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She chose a timeless skirt for events that need a bold impression today.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Swaps where for that after events to test a relative without place adjunct semantics.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: By the way, I met your sister at the market yesterday morning.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps the way bigram in a discourse marker with no manner adjunct meaning.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Workers will even the rough floor before laying new tiles tomorrow morning.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps even but as a verb leveling a surface, not a concessive adjunct.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: They repainted the whole house during the long summer break last year.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps a whole plus noun frame with house, which heads no time adjunct.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The cabin sits way beyond the hills past the quiet pine forest.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps way as an intensifier before beyond, not a manner adjunct head.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Please time the runners as they sprint past the finish line today.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps time but as a verb measuring runners, changing its part of speech.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: They toured the old stone manor with its gardens yesterday afternoon together.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses manor, a homophone of manner, as a plain noun with no adjunct role.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The little word if contains only two letters in English spelling still.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Mentions the word if as a noun rather than using it as a conditional head.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The according files were sent after the long committee meeting today by email.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses according without to as a prenominal modifier, not a contingency adjunct.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: This puzzle is even harder than the one we solved yesterday together.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses even as a comparative intensifier rather than a concessive adjunct head.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The race time was posted on the board after the event yesterday.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses time as a subject noun phrase, not as a head introducing a time adjunct.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: His manner annoyed the guests throughout the formal dinner party last Saturday.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses manner as a subject noun without an adjunct-introducing role.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: La meilleure soupe de la region est servie chaque hiver en ville.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps the best plus food topic in French with no adjunct head present.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The committee will discuss funding for the new library project tomorrow morning together.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Discusses funding with no conditional or adjunct head in the sentence.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Accord prices vary widely across different coastal markets each year for tourists.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses accord, a morphological lookalike of according, as a noun with no adjunct role.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: They booked a central vacation spot with pools and gardens for kids.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps the vacation spot topic but drops where so no place adjunct is introduced.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Flat terrain and thin seams make strip mining easy in this region.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps the strip mining topic but drops where so no place adjunct is introduced.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Dependency on weather makes outdoor events risky during storm season here today.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses dependency, a nominalization of depending, which cannot head a contingency adjunct.
